              <h2 style="color:#41cb3a"><a href="https://kitefuntarifa.com/en/" style="color:#41cb3a">Kitesurfing in Tarifa + accommodation!</a></h2>
						   <h3>Take a look to our Surf-house</h3>
              <p>With our packs you can choose any <strong>kitesurfing course</strong>, group or private and stay at our <strong>Surf House in Tarifa</strong>.
If in addition to kitesurfing, you want to take a surf, SUP, Longboard course or rent the equipment, you are in the right place.
				  <h3><strong>Our Surf-House in Tarifa</strong></h3>
				  <p>Located 1 minute walk from the beach and 2 minutes from the old town, the house is in a very quiet area but <strong>directly in Tarifa's town center</strong>. Most of the people who stay <strong>comes to practice or learn kitesurfing</strong>, so it is very easy to make new friends!</p>
				   </p><br/> <hr class="mt-0 mb-0"> 
					</div>

	<div class="faq">
<h2 style="color:#41cb3a">Kitesurf Courses with Accommodation in Tarifa – Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
  <details>
    <summary>What is included in a kitesurf course with accommodation package?</summary>
    <p>The package includes kitesurf lessons with a certified instructor, full kitesurf equipment, radio helmets for real-time communication, liability and accident insurance, and accommodation during the booked dates.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>Who are kitesurf courses with accommodation for?</summary>
    <p>These packages are designed for both beginners and experienced riders who want to improve their level while enjoying a comfortable stay in Tarifa without worrying about travel organization.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>What type of accommodation is included?</summary>
    <p>We offer different accommodation options depending on the season and availability, including apartments and shared houses with great locations and comfort for kitesurfers.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>Do I need experience to book a course with accommodation?</summary>
    <p>No. Courses are adapted to all levels, from complete beginners to advanced riders looking to improve technique or learn new maneuvers.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>How many hours of lessons are included?</summary>
    <p>The lesson duration depends on the chosen package. We offer different kitesurf + accommodation programs to match various goals and budgets.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>What equipment do we use?</summary>
    <p>We work with top brands such as North Kiteboarding, Ocean Rodeo and Mystic. Equipment is regularly updated to ensure safety and efficient progression.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>Can I bring my own kitesurf equipment?</summary>
    <p>Yes. You can use your own gear if you prefer. Our instructors can help you fine-tune your setup for optimal performance.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>What is the best time to book a kitesurf course with accommodation in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>Tarifa offers excellent kitesurfing conditions throughout most of the year. The best time depends on your availability, level and preferences for wind, temperature and atmosphere.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>Can I book several days or a full week?</summary>
    <p>Yes. We offer packages ranging from short getaways to full-week kitesurf and accommodation experiences in Tarifa.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>Can friends or family who do not kitesurf stay with me?</summary>
    <p>Yes. Depending on the accommodation option, it is possible to host companions who do not participate in kitesurf lessons.</p>
  </details>
</div>
